create_Trainer: create a Trainer instance with an optimizer, number of classes, and batch count for model training
run_Trainer_update: run a training step by calling update with models, images, and targets to compute loss and backpropagate
run_Trainer_update_multigpu: run a multi-GPU training step by calling update with a list of model replicas across devices
reset_Trainer_metrics: reset the Trainer step counter and loss, top1, top5 metric meters to start fresh tracking
log_Trainer_metrics: log the current training batch progress, metrics, and estimated time remaining to stdout
